build_modulated_siren_model: build a ModulatedSiren model with configurable width, depth, and FiLM modulations for coordinate-based representation
build_latent_modulated_siren: build a LatentModulatedSiren model that generates FiLM modulations from a learned latent vector
create_coordinate_grid: create a normalized coordinate grid array for a given image resolution using get_coordinate_grid
partition_model_params: partition Haiku model parameters into weights and modulations using partition_params for meta-learning
update_modulation_params: update model parameters by replacing only the modulation values using update_params and pytree conversions
